# Command catalogue

<!-- commands:begin (generated by pnpm commands --write-doc; do not edit) -->

Line: alias or script - purpose; spend unless none; exposed MCP tool (`MCP` means `avc_` plus alias with `:`/`-` replaced by `_`). Exclusions: `pnpm commands --query <word>`.

### Project and workspace

- `campaign:production`, `campaign:next`, `campaign:brief`, `campaign:approve` - Campaigns ([guide](../docs/campaign-production.md)); purposes: `pnpm commands --query campaign`
- `preflight` - Environment check: Node, pnpm, ffmpeg, Chromium, uv, Blender, .env keys. Not `doctor` (pnpm shadows it)
- `bootstrap` - First-run setup: plan by scope, --apply repo steps, report for the user with machine limits and keys by goal ([guide](../SETUP.md))
- `harness:setup` - Wire this checkout into installed coding-agent harnesses: skill and agent links and the agentbros MCP server config ([guide](../docs/harnesses.md))
- `keys` - Which service keys are set (never values), what each unlocks, free or paid, and which goals they serve ([guide](../SETUP.md))
- `studio` - Remotion Studio preview
- `projects` - List projects under public/projects/; `avc_project_list`
- `next` - Any project's next step: detects its route (film, footage, campaign, timeline, playbook); playbook first in read; MCP
- `playbook` - Choose (--match), show, bind (--use) a task playbook; --uses: which playbooks name a tool ([guide](../playbooks/AGENTS.md)); MCP
- `memory` - The user's local memory (decisions, preferences, lessons, observations, episodes, gaps) and proposals ([guide](../memory/AGENTS.md)); MCP
- `memory:upstream` - Applied proposal as local patches and PR.md, leak-scanned; never pushes ([guide](../memory/AGENTS.md))
- `project:new` - Create a project directory and project.json; `avc_project_create`
- `project:remove` - Plan removal of one project's whole footprint; --yes deletes
- `workspace:clean` - Plan clearing generated data by scope; --yes deletes
- `assets:sync` - Fetch or rebuild shared media from committed manifests, sha256-verified; --check reports only ([guide](../docs/assets.md))
- `review:ui` - Open a project's review (Timeline page) in the local studio console; starts or reuses it ([guide](../docs/local-review-ui.md))
- `console` - Studio console: start or reuse the local server (detached, one for all projects), print its token URL; --stop stops it ([guide](../docs/console.md))
- `console:wait` - Wait for the user's console decision, control change or card answer, then print it (run in the background at a gate) ([guide](../docs/console.md))
- `console:card` - Post a typed agent card (compare, grid, rating, choice, question, markdown, media) to the console ([guide](../docs/console.md)); MCP
- `console:control` - Pause, resume or stop a project with the user's words; paused or stopped refuses other commands with PAUSED ([guide](../docs/console.md))
- `studio:open` - Open a project in Remotion Studio in its current state (render props, live updates), bound to 127.0.0.1; --status, --stop ([guide](../docs/console.md))
- `console:snapshot` - Write a self-contained, read-only HTML snapshot of a project's console view to out/<id>/console-snapshot.html ([guide](../docs/console.md))
- `step:unlock` - Time-limited, reasoned step-lease unlock (unlocks.jsonl); spend still needs approval ([guide](../docs/step-lease.md))
- `step:violations` - Step-lease violations by step and command; clean or not ([guide](../docs/step-lease.md)); MCP

### Film chain (bespoke)

- `narration:check` - Check a film's narration takes
- `film:route` - A film type's steps, agents, inputs, outputs and tools; --write-doc regenerates its doc ([guide](../docs/film-types.md)); MCP
- `film:init` - Create a bespoke project and spine, never overwriting; --playbook binds and defaults --type; own footage: footage:next; MCP
- `film:status` - Each step's state from validated files and input hashes; what is stale; MCP
- `film:next` - What the orchestrator does now: dispatch, run, ask the user or stop ([guide](../docs/production-chain.md)); MCP
- `film:brief` - Writes a step's deterministic subagent prompt to pipeline/briefs/; returns its path and the one-line dispatch (--print: full text); MCP
- `film:show` - Read-only digest of a step's inputs and outputs or one artefact: shape, counts, schema validity, chosen fields; MCP
- `film:done` - Check a step's done rule and record its inputs; --skip <reason> for a skippable step; MCP
- `film:approve` - Record the user's own words against an artefact's hash; a --proxy benchmark never counts as the user's
- `film:rights` - A replica's rights gate from the user's own words
- `film:policy` - A project's autonomy policy (pipeline/policy.json): grant, revise or show it, raise a guard limit; widening needs --answer ([guide](../docs/production-chain/autonomy.md))
- `film:revert` - Revoke a decision taken under the user's policy (pipeline/decisions.jsonl) and reopen its step ([guide](../docs/production-chain/autonomy.md))
- `feedback` - The user's feedback on a film, recording edit or campaign variant: routes each quote to its step and reopens it; preview until --confirm ([guide](../docs/production-chain/feedback.md))
- `creative:stimuli` - Seeded creativity stimuli for a method (zwicky, scamper, triz, synectics, random-entry, kill-first-10); MCP
- `creative:pool` - Pool concept ideas or script variants blind, shuffled with a seed; seals the review step; MCP
- `creative:rank` - Rank the creative director's review on the frozen rubric and compute the verdict; MCP
- `creative:pick` - Write concept.json or script.json from the ranked review; MCP
- `creative:bench` - Benchmark two runs outside the chain: blind merged pools, judges' briefs, analysis ([guide](../docs/creative-benchmark.md)); MCP
- `concept:boards` - Hook, turn and last frames of each idea from library blocks, plus a contact sheet; MCP
- `film:targets` - Pace, stillness, loudness and sync targets from a reference or video (--manual on the CLI); MCP
- `plan:check` - Block a slideshow plan before building: pace, carry, entrances, layers, holds, reading time; MCP
- `film:stills` - Stills and a contact sheet at every cue, before rendering; MCP
- `film:render` - Render a bespoke film, mux, measure, write its and delivery's receipts; refuses silence unless decided; MCP
- `film:versions` - List or prune a film's kept renders
- `film:measure` - Measure a render against targets, audio map and cue sheet; each leg states its fix; MCP
- `shot:tournament` - Hero shot variants: sensors, corpus, blind pairs
- `critic:pack` - Sheets, strips at cuts, curves, loudness and phone sheet for a fresh critic; MCP

### Footage editing (the user's own recording)

- `local:verify` - Exercise native tasks and retain expiring smoke or pinned quality evidence ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `test:apple` - Gated actual Apple framework verification
- `local:capabilities` - Task-aware local capability diagnostics; --all includes unavailable backends ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `local:policy` - Read or set local interaction and model download policy ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `text:analyse` - Native language, token, sentence, lemma and entity observations ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `text:translate` - Local scene or caption-cue translation candidates; no invented word timings ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `voiceover:local` - Apple or portable local voice draft takes with provenance and portable word timing ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `audio:events` - Native timed sound classification observations ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `media:vision` - Native face, person, pose, saliency, quality, tracking and optical flow observations ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `text:assist` - Structured local Foundation Models draft notes with source IDs ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `image:describe` - Local Foundation Models image descriptions when supported ([guide](../docs/local-macos.md))
- `footage:next` - A user's recording's next step from files only, with filled-in commands; --playbook binds it ([guide](../docs/footage-editing.md)); MCP
- `footage:policy-apply` - Answer a footage:next question from the policy; logged
- `transcribe` - Scribe or fal to TranscriptSchema; --from-raw replays saved JSON free ([guide](../docs/speech.md)) **paid**; MCP
- `speech:local` - Free local TranscriptSchema file and Silero VAD speech-mask.json ([guide](../docs/speech.md))
- `footage:shots` - Frame-exact cuts, dissolves and fades in a video: shots.json and a storyboard ([guide](../docs/footage-shots.md)); MCP
- `recut:plan` - Unapproved recut request and recut-plan.md (fillers, retakes, pauses) from a transcript, with the hash to approve ([guide](../docs/workflows/recording-edit.md)); MCP
- `shorts:prepare` - Shorts step 1: numbered sentences in chunks and the candidate brief; MCP
- `shorts:rank` - Shorts step 2: validate, score and snap candidates into unapproved ShortSelection drafts ([guide](../.agents/skills/recording-recut/references/shorts-selection.md)); MCP
- `shorts:calibrate` - Shorts threshold from human 1-5 ratings of ranked clips; MCP
- `shorts:request` - Shorts step 3: chapters and, from the user's approved selections, the shorts-series request; MCP
- `multicam:sync` - Put several recordings on one clock by their sound, with a drift check ([guide](../docs/multicam-reframe.md)); MCP
- `multicam:angles` - Propose which camera to show when; optional timeline add-track command ([guide](../docs/multicam-reframe.md)); MCP
- `reframe:track` - Landscape-to-vertical or square crop path from face and person tracking ([guide](../docs/multicam-reframe.md)); MCP
- `photo:focus` - Faces (local YuNet) and start and end crops per format for stills, ready for the photo-move block
- `matte` - Free local cut-outs (Vision/BiRefNet): PNGs, alpha, ProRes ([guide](../docs/matte.md))
- `media:ingest` - Import a recording and build its source index; MCP
- `media:selects` - Lexical or vector selects; explicit --apply to a track; MCP
- `media:broll` - Plan or apply a reviewed muted B-roll track; MCP
- `media:words` - Word-timing proposals from a source index
- `media:local` - Installed offline ASR and embedding engines
- `media:ocr` - Local OCR with a trusted prepared config
- `media:visual` - Local native image-distance search
- `media:category` - Local native image-category classify and search
- `media:prepare` - Prepare free local speech and screen-text engines outside the repository
- `media:corpus` - Fixed AI/TTS corpus diagnostics
- `captions:export` - Sidecar SRT/VTT subtitles from exact caption timings, no ASR; burned-in captions: timeline:edit caption-style; MCP
- `captions:place` - Place captions clear of faces, screen text and platform UI; measure legibility; write the caption-style command
- `video:longform` - Chapters, approved shorts and exact assembly; plans unless --apply; `avc_longform`
- `speech:replace` - Plan, prepare and apply a reversible, reviewed phrase replacement ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)) **may-spend**

### References

- `refs:derive` - Plan, run and show immutable reference derivatives: ffmpeg steps, Blender passes, paid fal depth/pose/mask/audio-clean jobs (--confirm-spend) ([guide](../docs/reference-packs.md)) **may-spend**; MCP
- `refs:pack` - Prepare, check and approve immutable reference packs: measured attachments, compiled prompt and markers, exact request, board and result review ([guide](../docs/reference-packs.md)); MCP
- `refs:plan` - Draft, check and track each generated shot's reference requirements in references.json, with the command that resolves each ([guide](../docs/reference-packs.md)); MCP
- `ref:add` - Add a reference from a file or link, with rights and crop detection; MCP
- `ref:analyze` - Measure a reference's shots, speech, text, audio, motion and sync; contact sheets; MCP
- `ref:validate` - Validate a reference's layers and list missing measured and judged layers; MCP
- `ref:redact` - Keep a film's words local; tracked speech-text is structure
- `ref:contribute` - Check references before contributing ([guide](../docs/contributing-references.md))
- `ref:corpus` - All analysed references at once: metric spreads, techniques by function, gaps ([guide](../docs/reference-analysis.md)); MCP
- `ref:degrade` - Labelled degraded copies of a reference clip
- `ref:rate` - Record the user's 1-5 rating of a styleframe, reference or render in pipeline/ratings.json; a note becomes a memory preference ([guide](../docs/console.md))
- `ref:compare` - Compare a recreation with its reference: aligned shot pairs, colour, camera, findings; MCP
- `ref:replica-check` - Validate a replica spec against its reference shot by shot; MCP

### Music, sound and sync

- `music` - Music route question, stock and chart search, shortlist, acquire, record, rights check ([guide](../design-reference/music-sources.md)); MCP
- `music:backtime` - Rank track offsets that land a strong moment on the end card
- `elevenlabs:capabilities` - Offline ElevenLabs capabilities; optional explicit metadata refresh ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)); MCP
- `voices` - Search voices or inspect readiness; never creates or selects one ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)); MCP
- `voices:manage` - Plan or resume voice design, creation, cloning, training and pronunciation dictionaries ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)) **may-spend**; MCP
- `generate:dialogue` - Plan or resume multi-speaker dialogue with source-bound character timing ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)) **paid**; MCP
- `audio:transform` - Plan or resume isolation and voice conversion as immutable derived audio ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)) **paid**; MCP
- `dubbing:conform` - Conform selected dub spans to immutable scene MP3s with source receipts ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)); MCP
- `dubbing` - Plan, resume and sync versioned dubbing projects and language outputs ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)) **may-spend**; MCP
- `sfx:find-segment` - Find sound events in a recording with prepared Earshot; no automatic trimming ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)); MCP
- `sfx:map` - A recording's or reference's candidate sound events by cue family, with densities and gaps (prepared Earshot) ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md))
- `sfx:audition` - Choose each hero cue's sound from measured candidates, with Earshot's advisory audit when prepared ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md))
- `audio:review` - Advisory Earshot checks plus independent local loudness measurement ([guide](../docs/audio-integrations.md)); MCP
- `audio:map` - A track's tempo, grid, drums, phrases, sections and key moments as a map and PNG; MCP
- `audio:curves` - Per-frame curves from an audio map for audio-reactive motion
- `audio:stems` - Split a track into drums, bass, other and vocals with Demucs (downloads weights)
- `audio:describe` - CLAP moods, genres, SFX kinds and descriptors for any audio
- `audio:analyze` - Measure loudness, peak and silence of a local file; MCP
- `audio:mix` - Measured local mix to a master from a plan or edited project; MCP
- `audio:master` - Master one rendered file to a loudness preset without a timeline; MCP
- `audio:masking` - Predicted audibility of placed SFX under music and voice, with fixes
- `audio:syncmap` - PNG and JSON of cuts against beats, SFX and masking over the final mix
- `audio:editorial` - Offline rhythm, SFX, cues and cost-to-finish forecast; `avc_editorial_audio`
- `audio:repair` - Repaired MP4 from a preserved original
- `edit:snap` - Snap cue drafts to an audio map, frame-exact, or suggest cuts; MCP
- `edit:plan` - Edit skeleton from the map's structure (calm, punchy, flurry)
- `sfx:synth` - Procedural seeded SFX pack in the film's key, frame-exact risers; MCP
- `sfx:generate` - Project SFX or video foley take; --dry-run first **paid**; MCP
- `sfx:cues` - Block cues to placed sounds and an audio:mix plan; --fix-masking applies safe fixes
- `sfx:index` - Measured SFX index; --clap adds embeddings and tags
- `sfx:find` - SFX search by text (CLAP) and measured shape
- `sfx:fetch` - Fetch or rebuild the SFX collection from its manifests
- `sfx:library` - CC0 SFX cache, search by material and length, whoosh and riser synthesis

### Motion library

- `library:usage` - Blocks each film used (repetition)
- `library:list` - Motion library catalogue: filter by category, query or format; --id for props and previews
- `library:preview` - Render contact sheets of library items into docs/library/previews/
- `library:catalogue` - Regenerate docs/library/catalogue.json from the registry; run after changing a block

### Render, timeline and finishing backends

- `colour:scopes` - Scopes of a video or still: waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope, histogram, CIE xy, false colour, a contact sheet and exposure, cast, saturation and skin numbers ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:compare` - Compare a clip with a reference: side-by-side scopes, zone and paired CIEDE2000, and a diagnosis such as shadows cooler, saturation +12% ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:match` - Solve an editable grade.json (lift, gamma, gain, saturation, curve) that matches a clip to a reference, with before/after evidence ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:grade` - Apply a declarative grade.json or a per-shot timeline to a video or still through a baked 3D LUT, and export the .cube for Resolve ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:check` - Validate a rendered grade against its source (and a reference): skin chroma, hue and yellow drift, clipping, crushed blacks, saturation, legal range ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:looks` - Try genre looks (film, commercial, music video) on a clip with skin held, as a labelled grid with a gate verdict per look and an editable grade each ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:target` - Profile a reference per shot into target.json (levels, palette, scheme, skin, mood) for colour:check --target; with --mood, bounded per-shot grades ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:lut` - Import a .cube or HaldCLUT with its licence on record (unknown licences refused), for colour:looks --lut ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:track` - Track a power window over a moving subject so a grade's shape window follows it, with a preview of every lost frame ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `colour:shots` - Measure every shot of an edit (or several clips) against a hero shot, flag colour drift and optionally solve per-shot match grades ([guide](../docs/colour-grading.md))
- `vork:setup`, `vork:scene`, `vork:render`, `vork:recipe`, `vork:bridge`, `vork:vfx`, `vork:eval` - Vork local 3D and VFX ([guide](../docs/vork.md)); purposes: `pnpm commands --query vork`
- `viz:list` - Discover visualisation recipes and strict JSON requests; MCP
- `viz:prepare` - Prepare immutable data visualisation revisions; MCP
- `viz:inspect` - Inspect pinned visualisation plans and sources; MCP
- `viz:preview` - Render prepared visualisation stills; MCP
- `viz:render` - Render immutable visualisation video; MCP
- `viz:mount` - Place prepared 2D visualisation over a revision-checked timeline; MCP
- `render` - Render a project or timeline; --frames renders a partial excerpt; `avc_render_project`
- `timeline:edit` - Reversible, revision-checked timeline edits incl. burned-in caption-style (--init, --undo, --redo); MCP
- `motion:render` - Render a composition or range, optionally import it and return the next timeline:edit; MCP
- `motion:still` - Render exact frames of a composition to PNGs ([guide](../docs/agent-vision.md)); MCP
- `test:render` - Synthetic local render; never loads .env or calls APIs
- `hyperframes:render` - Render a Hyperframes composition with the external CLI, plus provenance
- `blender:city` - Cache OSM buildings and credits
- `blender:improve` - Blender blind A/B and history
- `blender:arsenal` - Arsenal audit, capability candidates, eval
- `blender:ext` - Blender extensions, pinned
- `blender:run` - Trusted Python/.blend; frames and contact sheet
- `camera:solve` - Moving-camera solve: tracks, Blender libmv, metric scale; camera.json for Vork ([guide](../.agents/skills/vork-3d-vfx/references/vfx.md))
- `blender:live` - Live Blender: arsenal, stills, replay ([guide](../.agents/skills/blender-3d/references/live-session.md)); MCP
- `blender:recipe` - Blender VFX/nature recipes
- `blender:scene` - Declarative Blender scene to frames
- `backend` - Probe optional backends and export finishing handoffs (Blender, Resolve, Hyperframes); MCP
- `capture:html` - Capture trusted offline HTML as deterministic PNGs or MP4 ([guide](../docs/html-capture.md)); MCP
- `capture:app` - Frame-exact capture of a real web app with scripted steps on an injected clock ([guide](../docs/capture-app.md))
- `resolve:handoff` - Probe or apply a prepared Resolve handoff to an isolated clone ([guide](../docs/resolve-worker.md)); MCP

### Vision, QA and delivery

- `viz:check` - Validate pinned visualisation revision integrity; MCP
- `motion:strip` - Consecutive frames, difference maps or a per-shot contact sheet; --vs a reference ([guide](../docs/agent-vision.md)); MCP
- `flash:check` - WCAG 2.3.1 flash sensor over every frame of any video: FLASH_RISK ranges of general or saturated-red flashes; MCP
- `judge:calibrate` - Sensor and blind-critic accuracy on degraded pairs
- `motion:check` - Computational sensors over a composition: counters that must read zero, each with its fix; MCP
- `vision:evaluate` - Prepare and run blind visual agent acceptance with observed image delivery ([guide](../docs/agent-vision.md))
- `vision:pack` - Paginated review frames, crops, evidence and source-bound manifest ([guide](../docs/agent-vision.md)); MCP
- `vision:inspect` - Verify and read bounded review evidence without writes ([guide](../docs/agent-vision.md)); MCP
- `review:sheet` - One storyboard image with timecodes, captions, waveform and cut marks; MCP
- `qa:screenshots` - Extract render screenshots for human QA; MCP
- `qa:evidence` - Measured render evidence: frame events and browser layout; MCP
- `qa:editorial` - Editorial QA report of a timeline or render; `avc_editorial_qa`
- `validate:render` - ffprobe, audio levels and screenshots of a render; findings
- `chart:inspect` - Read-only chart declaration and source correspondence; MCP
- `craft:evaluate` - Offline craft rubrics and evaluation of supplied evidence; `avc_craft_evaluation`
- `delivery` - Strict delivery snapshot and check, or a native-audio handoff packet; never uploads ([guide](../docs/delivery.md)); MCP
- `store:conform` - App store preview conform

### Recipes, workflows, campaigns and the pipeline findings check

- `pipeline:check` - Stateless findings probe: artefact schemas, file references, charts, creative and film findings; `avc_pipeline_status`
- `align:captions` - ElevenLabs forced alignment of voiceover to per-scene .words.json **paid**; MCP
- `asset:fetch` - Dispatch one asset from asset-plan.json (may generate paid media) **may-spend**; MCP
- `asset:fetch-all` - Dispatch every pending asset in asset-plan.json (may generate paid media) **may-spend**; MCP
- `video:recipe` - List, preview and materialise recipe animatics and templates; MCP
- `video:workflow` - product-ad, education, recording-edit and shorts-series workflows from supplied originals; MCP
- `campaign` - Campaign variants, localisation and outcomes; never generates or publishes; MCP

- `resources:icons`, `resources:icons:read`, `resources:logos`, `resources:logos:read`, `resources:icon-profile`, `resources:icon-profile:read` - Icon and logo resources ([guide](../docs/icon-resources.md)); purposes: `pnpm commands --query icons`

- `resources:font` - Import a licensed font or icon original and build font contexts; `avc_font_resource`

- `generate:model` - Schema-validated modern fal operation; --dry-run first **paid**; MCP
- `generate:image` - Legacy-compatible image generation with budget guards **paid**; MCP
- `generate:meme` - generate:image with gpt-image-2 **paid**
- `generate:video` - Legacy-compatible video generation with budget guards **paid**; MCP
- `generate:voiceover` - ElevenLabs or fal voiceover for every scene or one --scene **paid**; MCP
- `generate:music` - ElevenLabs Music, or a fal music model as a durable job **paid**; MCP
- `generate:stream` - One bounded HTTP image stream; offline plan unless --execute **paid**; MCP
- `generate:realtime` - One bounded realtime session; offline plan by default **paid**; MCP
- `realtime:editor` - Offline realtime editor drafts and queue; no generation; MCP
- `rmbg` - Background removal (fal birefnet), durable job; free: matte **paid**; MCP
- `upscale` - Image upscale (fal aura-sr) as a durable job **paid**; MCP
- `models:prices`, `models:compare`, `models:refresh` - Cross-provider model tools ([guide](../docs/higgsfield.md)); purposes: `pnpm commands --query models`
- `hf:sync`, `hf:pricing`, `hf:media`, `hf:quote`, `hf:usage` - Higgsfield tools ([guide](../docs/higgsfield.md)); purposes: `pnpm commands --query higgsfield`
- `budget` - Project ceilings, status, receipts and reconciliation; no provider request; MCP
- `job:cancel` - Cancel one paid job on the user's words where the provider supports it; otherwise marks it unavailable ([guide](../docs/console.md))
